==Purpose of template==
Displays a featured article that changes every day.

==How to use==
<pre><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Featuredarticle|''page='''page'''<nowiki/>''<nowiki>}}</nowiki></pre>

The '''''page''''' parameter is optional and specifies that the given page should be used instead of a random one. This is mainly useful for testing.

Add {{t|Featuredicon}} to pages that should be featured.

==Caveats==
'''Warning''': Pages that use <code><nowiki>{{PAGENAME}}</nowiki></code> and other magic words as input to templates may render poorly.

==Examples==
<pre><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Featuredarticle|page=Min Farshaw<nowiki>}}</nowiki></pre>
{{Featuredarticle|page=Min Farshaw}}

<pre><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Featuredarticle<nowiki>}}</nowiki></pre>
{{Featuredarticle}}


<!-- This is an attempt to hide the footnotes section, but it may or may not work depending on the page being transcluded -->
<div style="display:none;"><references /></div>
